releaseGates.title: Coordinated privacy rollout
releaseGates.requirement: Deploy matching web/mobile builds and local profile/storage migrations; verify hosted boundaries and stop older assessment training capture/export workers. Local tests do not secure the live deployment.

releaseGates.title: Release and device privacy checks
releaseGates.requirement: User to verify matching phone release using the checklist; verify web attachment expiry, missing files and unrelated-account denial on the deployed candidate.

releaseGates.title: PostGIS owner-level remediation
releaseGates.requirement: Supabase must remove client mutation grants on spatial_ref_sys while preserving reference reads and transforms. Application code cannot revoke these owner-controlled grants.

releaseGates.title: After-photo completion regression
releaseGates.requirement: Separate task must resolve the failing after-photo auto-completion test and verify the intended completion flow. This task leaves that implementation untouched per user instruction.

releaseGates.title: Maintenance deployment and alert delivery
releaseGates.requirement: Deploy the retention migration and handlers, observe successful scheduled runs and verify controlled failure alert delivery. Live preflight still shows maintenance failures.

releaseGates.title: Hosted backup, Storage recovery and database upgrade
releaseGates.requirement: Verify recoverable hosted backups/PITR and a separate Storage object recovery plan, then schedule a supported database upgrade and recovery checks. The successful local restore does not prove hosted recovery.

releaseGates.title: Stripe sandbox journey and reconciliation
releaseGates.status: Local sandbox verified; release checks open
releaseGates.requirement: Local acceptance/signature/payment/refund/transfer/reconciliation checks passed in Phase 6. Verify matching mobile checkout/3DS and deployed webhook delivery/monitoring before beta; bank settlement is not asserted by sandbox transfers.
